pages.text:
A chassis has three tanks, **Orange**, **Green** and **Purple**, of 4,000 mB each. A tank holds one fluid at a time and never mixes: offering a different fluid simply fails.

A **Fluid Port** connects one tank to the touching tank or machine, in the same passive/import/export modes as an Item Port. Machines take fluid from the **Orange** tank and put fluid into the **Green** tank unless you choose otherwise; fluid engines burn from the **Purple** tank.
If a machine says it has the wrong fluid, empty that tank (export it, or choose a different tank on the machine screen) and fill it with the fluid named in the message.
